```plato

    // The dense index of a corner's undirected edge: how many canonical corners
    // precede this edge's own canonical corner. Both halves of a twin pair give
    // the same answer, a boundary corner names its own edge, and the results
    // cover [0, UndirectedEdgeCount) on open and closed meshes alike.
    CornerUndirectedEdge(self: PolygonMesh3D, corner: CornerIndex): UndirectedEdgeIndex
    {
        var twin = self.TwinCorner(corner);
        var canonical = twin.IsNone ? corner.Value : corner.Value.Min(twin.Value);
        return UndirectedEdgeIndex(canonical
            .MapRange(c => self.IsCanonicalCorner(CornerIndex(c)) ? 1 : 0)
            .Reduce(0, (acc, hit) => acc + hit));
    }
```
